02 /About

Economics is where
I start.

I studied economics at the University of Houston, with a minor in entrepreneurship. I’m interested in how businesses make decisions when the data are incomplete and the tradeoffs matter.

My projects follow that interest: check the source, make a fair comparison, test an explanation and communicate what the evidence can support.
